states.title: ProjectSites — AI Website Builder, Live in 4 Minutes
states.visibleText: Project Sites builds and deploys complete AI-generated websites for small business in under 15 minutes on Cloudflare Workers. The AI gateway routes each prompt to the right model by complexity — instant responses via Workers AI (free), routine generation via DeepSeek, premium reasoning via Anthropic Claude or OpenAI. Every publish runs an axe-core accessibility gate at six viewports and a Lighthouse Core Web Vitals gate, blocking deploys that fail WCAG 2.2 AA or LCP under 2.5 seconds.
